description_en: Queries the tags bound to one or more Edge Node Service (ENS) resources. Currently, only instance resources are supported
description_zh: 查询一个或多个ENS资源（目前只支持实例资源）已经绑定的标签列表
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Valid values: instance (instance)
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义。取值：instance（实例）
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

You must specify at least one of ResourceId and Tag. Otherwise, the MissingParameter.ResourceIdsOrTags error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID，n 的取值范围为 [1, 50]

ResourceId 与 Tag 至少须指定一个，否则服务返回 MissingParameter.ResourceIdsOrTags
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

The tag key cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`.
The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length.
The tag key cannot be an empty string
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20。

不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或`https://`开头。
最多支持64个字符。
不允许传入空字符串
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the topic. You must specify both Key and Value or neither. If both are specified, the system filters topics based on the tag. If neither is specified, all topics are queried.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
The tag value can be an empty string.
The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with aliyun or acs:, or contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
Topic的标签值。Key和Value值必须同时输入或同时不输入。若同时输入表示根据Tag过滤符合条件的Topic，若不输入表示查询所有Topic。

N的取值范围为1~20。
如果输入该值，取值允许为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag list.

You must specify at least one of ResourceId and Tag. Otherwise, the MissingParameter.ResourceIdsOrTags error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。

ResourceId 与 Tag 至少须指定一个，否则服务返回 MissingParameter.ResourceIdsOrTags
parameters.name: tag

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the associated resource

TagKey.description_en: The tag key of the instance
